claims.finding: enableSkillCommands is current and defaults true. Current skills is a string-path array; the older object form is migrated in settings loading. Command exposure is separate from skill loading and model visibility.

claims.claim: The listed settings fields establish the TypeScript-only settings gap.
claims.finding: The current source has more specific nested paths and validation: images.blockImages, terminal.imageWidthCells and warnings.anthropicExtraUsage; appearance is version 2. claims.claim: Legacy compatibility helpers imply automatic legacy environment/path aliases.
claims.finding: The current small legacy-compat helpers read the supplied environment name and construct the canonical configured path; their filenames do not prove automatic legacy aliases. Historical migration/import behavior belongs to the separately inspected CLI path.

claims.claim: The HTTP dispatcher adds an idle timeout and proxy support.
claims.finding: TS configures Undici response headers/body timeouts and environment-proxy dispatching. Native reqwest pool_idle_timeout controls retained idle connections instead, so equal-looking setting names are not active-response timeout parity.

claims.claim: The historical import copied only five settings, with the remaining named keys TS-only.
